title: AWS Architecture & Design Patterns
description: Think like an AWS architect. Learn architecture patterns, design principles, and the Well-Architected Framework pillars in depth.
longDescription: This module covers AWS architecture patterns and design principles. You will learn how to design 3-tier and serverless architectures, apply AWS design principles for scalability and reliability, use the Well-Architected Framework for reviews, and choose patterns for microservices and event-driven systems.
whatYouLearn: Apply AWS design principles for scalability and reliability
Use the Well-Architected Framework for reviews
Choose patterns for microservices and event-driven systems
